integrity: Exact rational finite tests accompany a self-contained all-parameter proof; no external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous independent binary deletion; known source length and two adjacent positions; one surviving nonzero marker at most; fixed retention p strictly between 0 and 1. The finite-distance optimization is specific to this hypothesis pair. Asymptotic constants are not uniform in p. No independent validation, broader reconstruction algorithm, or confirmed global historical priority.
title: Optimal adjacent-marker trace tests and hypergeometric maximum formula
